title: Boston Food & Cocktail Tour: Discover the South End After Hours
includes: All Food & Drink Tastings From Local Eateries
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 12 people per booking
*This small-group tour experiences requires a minimum of 4 guests to operate. If the minimum is not met, you will be offered the option to reschedule or receive a full refund.
policies: PLEASE NOTE: In the Special Requirements field at check out, please advise any dietary restrictions or food allergies. We will do our best to accommodate WITH advance notice. As all tastings are coordinated with the eateries in advance of our arrival, we are unable to make changes on the fly on the day of the tour. Thank you for your cooperation.
Gratuities are not included but are greatly appreciated by tour guides!
A moderate amount of walking is involved; wear comfortable walking shoes to accommodate standing for long periods
New England is subject to inclement weather, please rain gear in the event of a sudden weather change
We operate and have fun in all weather conditions - please dress appropriately for the forecast!
Please bring a bottle of water if you would like to have something to drink throughout the tour
Metered parking in the South End has a 2-hour limit; this is shorter than the duration of your tour, so it is suggested that you park in a garage to avoid violations
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Local Foods, Libations & Lots of Fun! 
Visit the local eateries Boston's South End residents call home. Walk to 4 different locations, where each visit includes an alcoholic beverage paired with your food tasting.

Food Tastings are representative of the diverse food scene in Boston's South End neighborhood and may include visits to a Creole / Asian Fusian hotspot, French-Cambodian restaurant, a beloved Wine and Cheese shop, and a Mexican lounge. When it comes to food - and cocktails - Boston's South End is not to be missed!

Available exclusively on Wednesdays and Fridays at 4:30pm.
